doc_title: SupportED back-to-school webinar, concept image library, locked navy/gold system

images.concept: A single school report card lying on a kitchen table at morning light, all top grades visible as abstract marks, one small shadow falling across its lower edge. Emotion: false reassurance, something unseen.
Two identical clipboards side by side on a clean ground, one glowing warm gold, one cool navy, subtly different in the shape of their marks. Emotion: these measure different things.
An iceberg seen in cross-section, the small bright tip above the waterline and the vast mass below in navy. Emotion: what the grade shows versus what the exam tests.
Back-view silhouette of a parent seated alone at a kitchen table at night, a single warm lamp, papers spread out. Emotion: quiet worry, carrying it alone.
A wall calendar with the first six weeks of a term marked by a warm gold band, the remaining months fading to navy. Emotion: the window is now and it is narrow.
Two doors in a plain wall, one open with warm light spilling out, one closed and cool. Emotion: the fork, ahead or reactive.
An ornate key resting beside a closed folder, warm gold light catching the key. Emotion: the scoring rules exist and nobody showed you them.
Morning fog lifting off a still landscape to reveal a clear path, gold light breaking through navy haze. Emotion: the anxiety disappears because the mystery disappears.
A single desk in an empty exam hall, clock on the far wall, one shaft of light. Emotion: the timed free response, the moment it gets real.
Abstract ascending steps rendered as clean flat blocks rising from navy into gold. Emotion: steady built progress, not a panic sprint.
